title: One machine's source bindings
description: Where this machine keeps the project's sources, at `.amiga-re/local.json`. Deliberately outside the project's document set: the root document does not index it, no digest covers it, and it is git-ignored, because a host path that is true on one machine is noise on every other. It exists because a project document never contains a host path — `locations` is a hint and the identity is the digest — so a project whose media lives elsewhere needs somewhere to say where. A binding wins over the project's own hint.

bindings.description: Source ID to host path. A relative path resolves against the project root, so a binding stays meaningful when the project and its media move together. A path reached through a symbolic link is refused rather than followed.
